book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Yesu kanguyeghwa kwa Pilato
Malabhila putiputi hilongohi bha andundame bhoha na hilongo bha Ayahudi bhakikongan kangi, bhatende luhila lwa kunkoma Yesu.
Bhakimmopa lughoyi na bhakinnyegha kwa Pilato, ywakabheghite ntabhala ywa Akaaloma.
Yuda kangulipopotola

Mbole Yuda ywene ywakankilukite Yesu, pakabhonite kukita Yesu katoswa, kakihyongoloka munu, kakibhuyiha hipalamande salasini hya magwala hyakapeghitwe na hilongohi bha andundame na hilongohi bha Ayahudi.
Kakilongela, “Ndenda ulemwa, kiyaha nughukiluka mwahi ghuutendite ng'obhe uhokelo ghwa kukomwa.” Ndo bhakinnyanga, “Aghwo chepa nnando ghwa kughuhwachila twenga, habhu ghumanye ghumwene.”
Ndo Yuda kakihitagha hila hipalamande hya magwala ku Nyumba ya Chapanga, kakibhuka na kakighenda kulipopotola mwene.

Bhala andundame akulu bhakighatola ghala maghwala na bhakilongela, “Yingunoghwa ng'obhe kuhangangana magwala agha na magwala gha Nyumba ya Chapanga, kiyaha magwala agha ghahombwa ngati mundu kakomwe.”
Basi, mbole ya kughombana, bhakilamula kuhemela nng'unda ghwa kingandu kya kubhumbila hyombo hya lutupi, ngati pabheghe pakuakulila ahenja.
Ndo mana mbaka lelo bhandu bhangughukema nng'unda aghwo nng'unda ghwa mwahi.
Ndo likitwihilika lila lilagho lya mbuye Yelemia kukita, “Bhakitola hipalamande salasini hya magwala, bei yakapangilitwe na bhandu bha Isilaeli,
bhakihemelela nng'unda ghwa kingandu kya kubhumbila hyombo hya lutupi, handa bhula Bambo pakakwilikihite.”
Pilato kangunkonya Yesu
Linjuba alyo alyo Yesu pakayimite muulongolo ghwa Pilato, nkulu ywa nkoa ywa Akaaloma, naywo kakinkonya Yesu, “Bhuli, Ghwenga ndo Mutwa ywa Akaayahudi?” Yesu kakinnyanga, “Ghwenga ghungulongela.”
Peni hilongohi bha andundame na hilongohi bha Ayahudi paankokilite kakiyanga ng'obhe lilagho.
Ndo Pilato kakinkonya, “Bhuli, ghunguyihwa ng'obhe ngokelo ahyo highukokelwa?”
Peni Yesu kakinnyanga ng'obhe hata kwa lilagho limu, kya habhu ntabhala kakikangacha munu.
Yesu kaangutoswa kiho
Basi, yikibhegha hitohe mulinjubha lya chekwa ntabhala ywa Aloma kummopola mmopwa yumu ywakahaghulitwe na lumati lwa bhandu.
Manjubha agho kakibhegha mmopwa yumu nhakata, ywakakemitwe Balaba.
Basi, lumati lwa bhandu palukonganite, Pilato kakiakonya, “Mungupala nubhabhopolele ywoki, Balaba ebu Yesu ywene ywakakemwa Kilisto?”
Kiyaha kakimanya kukita Yesu kakikamuhwa kwa ywombe kiyaha bhakimmonela tama.
Pilato pakatamite pa kiteho kyake kya toso, nhumbu ywake kakintaghila lilobhe ali, “Ghukotoke kuliyingiha mungokelo ywa mundu ayu ywa maha, kiyaha lelo mbamandika muno maloto kwakya ywombe.”
Peni hilongohi bha andundame na aghohi bhakilunyegheleha lula lumati lwa bhandu kukita ayupe ngati kabhopolelwe Balaba na Yesu kakakomwe.
Nkulu ghwa nkoa kakiakonya kangi, “Ndo ywoki mu abha abhili mungupala nibhahughulilile?” Bhakiyanga, “Balaba.”
Pilato kakiaghombela, “Hinu, ndende niki kwa ayu ywakakemwa Kilisto?” Bhakinnyanga, “Ghummambe mulupingika.”
Pilato kakiakonya, “Kiyaha niki? Katenda uhokelo ghwoki?” Peni bhombe bhakighendelela kuyobha kyobho, “Ghummambe mulupingika.”

Pilato pakabhonite katahotola ng'obhe kutenda kyohele, na kukita bhulwa ghunguyonjokeheka, kakitola machi, kakikuha mabhoko ghake muulongolo ghwa lula lumati lwa bhandu, pakalongela, “Nenga megha ng'obhe munnando ghwa kiho kya mundu ayu, maamanya mabhene.”
Bhandu bhoha bhakiyanga, “Chapanga katuhyate twenga na bhana bhetu kwa kiho kya mundu ayu.”
Ndo, kakiabhopolela Balaba na mbole ya kukwilikiha kuntuta Yesu hinjupunjupu hya liyula lya ndomondo hiikwatilitwe ndoana, kakimmuha ngati kabhambwe.
Machonda bhangunhwangila Yesu
Mbole, machonda bha Pilato, bhakinnyegha Yesu muludamu lwa utabhala, na machonda bhoha bhakintindila.
Bhakinhula mapinda ghake na bhakinhwaliha lipinda lya salabati,

Mbole, bhakitendekeha kilemba kya mihomi na bhakinhwika mumutwe ghwake. Bhakinpegha nhimbati mu kibhoko kyake kya nnilo, bhakichutama mayughwa muulongolo ghwake paalongela, “Mwika, Mutwa ywa Akaayahudi.”
Bhakinhunila mata, na bhakighutola ghula nhimbati mu mabhoko ghake na bhakintuta mu mutwe ghwake.
Mbole ya kuntendela agho, bhakinhula lila lipinda, bhakinhwaliha kangi lipinda lyake, na bhakintola ngati bhakammambe mulupingika.
Yesu kangubhambwa
Paabheghite munjila, bhakikongana na mundu yumu ywa ku Kilene, lihina lyake Simoni, nabho machonda bhakinkwilikiha kalugheghe lula lupingika.
Bhakihika pahala paakemitwe Goligota, fwambulo yake pahala palihuhu lya mutwe.
Bhakinpegha difwai yiihanganganitwe na lusunga. Peni Yesu pakapahite kakilema kunywegha.
Paammabite kala, bhakighabhana mapinda ghake kwa kutenda usimbi.
Mbole, bhakitama ngati bhankingikihe.
Unani mwa mutwe ghwake, mulupingika, bhaibhika lipapi liilembitwe, “AYU NDO YESU, MUTWA YWA AKAAYAHUDI.”
Mbole Apoka abhili bhakibhambwa papamu na ywobe kila mundu mulupingika lwake, yumu mbande yake ya nnilo na yungi mbande ya ngiya ya Yesu.
Bhandu bhaabheghite bhangupita ugheghela na apo, bhakinligha kunu paanokola mitwe yabhe na kunheka, paalongela,
“Ghwenga, ghuupala kuboghoyola Nyumba ya Chapanga na kuchenga kwa manjubha mandatu, hinu ghulilopole ghumwene na ghuhuluke muupingika. Handa ghwenga ndo Mwana ywa Chapanga.”
Ubhwabhu abhu, hilongohi bha andundame na ahunda bha Malaghilo na aghohi bhakinhwangila, paalongela,
“Kakialopoha bhangi, peni kanguhotola ng'obhe kulilopoha mwene. Ywombe ndo Mutwa ghwa Isilaeli. Hinu, kahuluke kuhuma mulupingika ndo twaanhyubhalila.
Kakinndumbila Chapanga, hino, Chapanga kanlopole handa kangupala, kiyaha ywombe kakilongela, ‘Nenga ndo Mwana ywa Chapanga.’ ”
Na bhala apoka bhaabhambitwe papamu na Yesu bhakinligha ubhwabhu abhu.
Kiho kya Yesu
Kutandila saa sita mbaka saa tisa nnima ghwoha likbhegha lubhindu totoloo.
Payihikite saa tisa Yesu kakilila kwa lilobhe likulu, “Eloi, Eloi lama Sabakitani?” Fwambulo yake, “Chapanga ywangu, Chapanga ywangu, bhuli ghunguneka?”
Amoo bhandu bhaayimite pala paayihwite agho bhakilongela, “Kangunkema Eliya.”
Kamu, yumu ywabhe kakibhutuka lubhilo na kuyegha libhoya liihanganganitwe na siki, kakiyibhika muludenge na kakinpegha Yesu ngati kanyweghe.
Bhangi bhakilongela, “Munneke, ngati tubhone handa Eliya katahika kunlopoha.”
Mbole Yesu kakilila kangi lilobhe likulu, ndo kakihwegha.
Lisaa alyo alyo, lipasia lya Nyumba ya Chapanga likibaluka hipalamande hibhili, kutandila kunane mbaka pahi. Nnima ghukilendema na matalabha ghakibaluka.
Mandogholo ghakigubutuka na mibhili ya bhandu bha maha yikihyuka.
Mbole ya Yesu kuhyuka bhakubhuka mumandogholo na bhakiyingila ku kitami king'anyimo na kubhegha bhandu bha ayoloho.

Ndo yula machonda kilongohi na bhala bhaabheghite papamu naywo paakinkingikiha Yesu, paabhonite nnima ghungulendema na ghoha ghaabwitukilite, bhakiyoghopa na bhakilongela, “Kulyaghila ayu kakibhegha Mwana ghwa Chapanga.”
Apo pakibhegha na adala paalolekeha kya kutali. Abho bhakintughila Yesu kuhuma Galilaya ngati bhantumikile.
Mubhombe bhakibhegha Malia mundu ywa kuhuma ku Magidala, Malia mama ywabhe Yakobu na Yosefu na mama ywabhe bhana bha Sebedayo.
Mmili ghwa Yesu ghungubhikwa mulindogholo
Payihikite makimuhi, kakihika mundu yumu yunautopelo ywakakemitwe Yosefu, kuhuma ku Alimataya, na aywo kakibhegha nhundwa ywa Yesu,
kakinng'endela Pilato, kughuyupa mmili ghwa Yesu. Pilato kakikwilikiha kapeghwe.
Yosefu kakighutola ghula mmili ghwa Yesu, kakighubhilingiha sanda huhu mbulete,
kakighubhika mulindogholo lya hyono lyakalihonguliti mwene mulitabhala. Mbole, kakibingiliha libho likulu mu nlyango ghwa lindogholo na kakighenda.
Malia ywa ku Magudala na yula Malia yungi bhakitama ugheghela ghwa lindogholo.
Lindogholo lingukingikihwa
Kilabho yake, ndo linjubha lya kupumulila, hilongohi bha andundame na Afalisayu bhakinng'endela Pilato,
bhakilongela, “Nkulu, tungukulungwa kukita yula nkubhuhi, kukali ya kuhwegha kakilongela, ‘Mbole ya majubha mandatu ndaahyuka.’

Basi, ghukwilikihe ngati lindogholo likingikihwe mbaka linjubha lya ndatu. Hela bhubho, ahundwa bhake bhatahotola kughuyibha mmili ghwake na kuaghombela bhandu kukita kahyuka. Ukubhuhi aghwo ghwa uhiko ghwaabhegha nhakata kyanalumu kupitingana ghula ghwa kalongohi.”
Pilato kakiaghombela, “Mwenga mmegha na machonda akingikiha. Nng'ende mukalikingikihe lindogholo handa bhula mummanya.”
Kya habhu, bhakighenda na machonda ngati bhakalikingikihe lindogholo kwa makakala ghoa, bhakibhika mango mu lila lindogholo na kubhika ukingiki ho.
